messages:
olivia.p: FYI console showed a spike in 'fallback-routing' bucket after the 1.8 SDK rollouts. Looks correlated with a proxy tweak earlier.
raj.platform: which SDKs? python/ts/go?
olivia.p: primarily TS 1.8.2 and Go 0.9.1 canaries. A few python users too but lower volume.
dave.sdk: we shipped a small optimization to attach `x-fallback-hint` when a cached pool is unhealthy. It was intended only for retry paths.
sophia.ops: ingest side sees `x-fallback-hint: model-quant` on many first-attempt requests, console attributes those to cheaper model usage -> billing and e2e cost dashboards are skewed.
ingest-bot: ingest-alert: 5% increase in fallback-routing aggregates (15m window) :rotating_light:
raj.platform: sounds like a contract mismatch: SDK assumes proxy annotates retries, proxy assumes SDK will mark retries, and console assumes annotation implies actual routing used.
dave.sdk: agree. quick fix: SDK will stop injecting fallback hint on initial attempts and only add it on retry. pushing WIP PR for TS: https://github.com/redwoodinc/ts-sdk/pull/801
olivia.p: can console temporarily ignore `x-fallback-hint` for aggregation and instead rely on final route chosen by router? that would avoid transient miscounting.
raj.platform: ingestion team can add a short-circuit mapping: if `initial=true` present then ignore fallback hints; but SDKs aren't setting `initial`. we should define a stable header semantics: `x-request-phase: initial|retry|redirect`
sophia.ops: ingestion can do a conservative backfill to reclassify affected windows for known tenants. low risk if we ensure idempotency. estimate 10-20min for the top 5 tenants.
dave.sdk: will add a test that the SDK never sets fallback on initial requests and add release note. also adding an opt-in flag for aggressive fallback behavior behind feature flag.
raj.platform: rollout plan: 1) ingestion mapping in dry-run for 1h 2) TS/Go SDK patch canary (5%) 3) run backfill for affected tenants 4) promote SDKs and remove dry-run.
olivia.p: please add a console banner for affected customers and a short support blurb. tagging @support in the draft.
ingest-bot: action created: INGEST-1243 (dry-run mapping) :white_check_mark:
sophia.ops: will monitor metrics and follow up in 2h with results.
raj.platform: long-term: formalize the SDK<->proxy<->ingest header contract in spec repo and add e2e telemetry smoke to SDK release pipeline (send one request to staging console and assert aggregation).
olivia.p: agreed. adding to next sprint planning.
